The Liga Profesional Argentina delivered another high-octane encounter as Defensa y Justicia hosted Gimnasia LP in a match filled with tactical intrigue and disciplinary drama. On August 10, 2026, fans witnessed a clash where the balance of power shifted drastically before the halftime whistle. The Breakthrough and Disciplinary Shift The match began with palpable intensity, forcing an early tactical adjustment in the 7th minute when Domingo Blanco replaced Agustin Hausch . The first major breakthrough occurred in the 32nd minute as Cesar Perez provided a clinical assist for Fernando Roman , who made no mistake in putting Defensa y Justicia ahead. However, the momentum took a sharp turn for the visitors shortly after. Jeronimo Russo , who had been cautioned just a minute before the goal, received a second yellow card in the 40th minute, resulting in a dismissal that left his side playing with ten men. Consolidation and Late Pressure Entering the second half with a numerical advantage, Defensa y Justicia looked to secure the points. In the 68th minute, Valentin Loza set up Tomas Perez , who doubled the lead with a composed finish. While the game seemed to be drifting toward a comfortable conclusion, Gimnasia LP showed great resilience. In the 83rd minute, Martin Ortega found Bruno Cabrera , who pulled one back to set up a grandstand finish. Despite late pressure and a yellow card for goalscorer Fernando Roman in stoppage time, the home side held firm to claim the victory when the referee blew the final whistle after 94 minutes of action.
